result.description:
Dalwallinu, Full Time, Trades & Services
Vacancy Listing Dates 15/07/2026 to 12/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17668
- Multiple opportunities available for DIDO positions
- Remuneration between $79,423 - $130,000 based on role and experience
- Join our team at Dallcon - Based in Dalwallinu

DALLCON has been manufacturing and supplying precast and custom concrete products to the Western Australian civil, mining, and agricultural industries since 2000.

Due to continued growth within our team, we are currently looking for experienced workers to join our team based in Dalwallinu. These are Monday to Friday DIDO roles. See below descriptions for each role:

CIVIL ENGINEERING DRAFTSPERSON
This position involves preparing detailed drawings and plans for civil engineering projects, supporting Civil Engineering Professionals and Engineering Technologists. Registration or licensing may be required.

TRUCK DRIVER (GENERAL)
Operates a large truck that necessitates a specially endorsed class of license for the transportation of oversized goods. Registration or licensing is required.

CONCRETE BATCHING PLANT OPERATOR
Operates a mixing plant to produce batches of concrete using cement, sand, aggregate, water, and various other ingredients.

EARTHMOVING PLANT OPERATOR (GENERAL)
Operates a variety of earthmoving equipment to facilitate the construction of roads, railways, water supply systems, dams, treatment plants, and agricultural earthworks. Registration or licensing is required.

LOADER OPERATOR
Operates a motorized loader to transport and load soil, rock, and various other materials. Registration or licensing is required.

MOBILE PLANT OPERATOR NEC
This occupational category includes Mobile Plant Operators who are not classified elsewhere. Registration or licensing may be required.

PROCUREMENT MANAGER
The individual is responsible for planning, organizing, directing, controlling, and coordinating the procurement and purchasing of materials, products, and services for the organization.

STEEL FIXER
The role involves positioning and securing steel bars and steel mesh within concrete forms to reinforce concrete structures. Registration or licensing may be required.

STRUCTURAL ENGINEER
The role involves analyzing the structural properties of various types of constructions, testing the behaviour and durability of materials utilized in their fabrication, and designing as well as overseeing the construction of diverse structures. It is important to note that registration or licensing may be required for this profession.

STONEMASON
Cuts and shapes both hard and soft stone blocks, as well as masonry slabs, to build and restore stone structures. Interprets plans and specifications to determine required materials, measurements, and installation methods.
